advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 16.63; 3/3 launches spun

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.301 over 17 corners (9 understeer, 1 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Rears lock first: brake balance forward, decel diff lock down.
advice.evidence: median deficit R 0.91 vs F 0.31; 4/7 stops

advice.text: Trail-brake understeer: finish more braking before steering; caster +0.5 for camber-in-turn.
advice.evidence: 5/17 corners red on the fronts at turn-in

advice.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
advice.evidence: 498 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

advice.text: Mixed axle signal — 10 front-limited vs 4 rear-limited of 17 corners. Not enough agreement for a balance call: repeat the same corner type several times before changing anything.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.56) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 7 stops (2 both-axle, 1 front-first, 4 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
